info.title: Joomla 6.2.0 Core Web Services API
info.description:
Core Joomla Web Services API routes, authentication, request and response schemas, and form parameters. Check x-support for operation availability. Replace example URLs, tokens and IDs with site values. Installed plugins can extend forms and responses.

## Authentication

Authentication is done using a Joomla API Token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or in the `X-Joomla-Token` header. To get the token, go to the user profile in your Joomla installation and activate and copy the API key. Basic authentication with username and password only works when its plugin is enabled. The Joomla Update endpoints use the separate `X-JUpdate-Token`.

## Response schemas

Response schemas and examples are derived from the Joomla source code; they are not captured from a site, unless the example says so.

## Components without web services

* com_associations supplies administrator tools for multilingual associations. It has no standalone web-services plugin or REST routes in these snapshots.
* com_finder manages the Smart Search index, maps and filters. It has no core REST search or indexing routes in these snapshots.

## Videos

[YouTube playlist about Joomla Web Services / APIs](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLsg93PS_2NeL850YZFlAi1Eb7hwxETNkX)

get.description:
Get a list of Banners Categories in the Joomla site.

Route defaults fix extension to com_content, com_contact, com_banners or com_newsfeeds. Do not move a category between component trees by changing extension. lft, rgt and level are maintained by Joomla.

The collection supports filter[state], an integer passed to the publication-state filter. For example, GET /content/categories?filter[state]=1 selects published article categories.

For tree positioning, the controller reads location and location_reference from the JSON body and calls setLocation after saving. location accepts before, after, first-child or last-child; the reference is the category ID, with parent_id used when no explicit reference is provided. Changing ordinary fields and positioning the record are separate steps, so read back the parent and ordering even when the initial save succeeds. Component plugins can add options to the base form. The base edit check requires core.manage and record core.edit, or core.edit.own with a matching owner; component overrides take precedence. Omitted SERVER_UTC/USER_UTC calendar values are restored from the stored UTC values after validation, avoiding a second timezone conversion.

get.description:
Get a list of configured Media Adapters. Adapters define storage backends and root paths for media files. For examples of how to use Media Adapters, please refer to

[https://github.com/joomla/joomla-cms/blob/6.0-dev/tests/System/integration/api/com_media/Adapters.cy.js](https://github.com/joomla/joomla-cms/blob/6.0-dev/tests/System/integration/api/com_media/Adapters.cy.js)

Discover adapter IDs through /media/adapters; local-images is site configuration, not a universal ID. /media/files/{path}/ lists a directory; the same path without the trailing slash reads one item. Only GET collection, GET item and PATCH item are registered. There is no plugin POST or DELETE route.

PATCH accepts only enabled, access and ordering in a flat JSON object. The controller checks the raw input: params, folder, element, name, a data wrapper or any other key causes HTTP 400. For example, {"enabled":1} is a supported state change; {"params":{"example":1}} is not.

get.description:
Get a list of Privacy Requests in the Joomla site.

List and item endpoints for requests and consents, together with the export endpoint, require core.admin on com_privacy. There is no consent DELETE route.

Creation, confirmation, export and removal are separate stages. Creating a request does not complete export or delete a user. The export action requires request_type: "export" and confirmed status 1; otherwise the model supplies no export data and the view raises a route-not-found exception.

Privacy plugins supply the export domains, but the API serialises their array as one resource. Its attributes can therefore be an array of domain names and descriptions, with an empty resource ID. Protected domain items are not included by that serializer. A missing ID can also raise a PHP warning and fail under stricter error handling. Do not treat this response as a complete personal-data export or as the export file produced in the administrator. Use the administrator export workflow when you need that complete result. There is no generic PATCH or DELETE workflow for request records. The base edit check requires core.manage and record core.edit, or core.edit.own with a matching owner; component overrides take precedence. Omitted SERVER_UTC/USER_UTC calendar values are restored from the stored UTC values after validation, avoiding a second timezone conversion.

sef.title: Search Engine Friendly URLs
sef.description: Joomla URLs normally look like index.php?option=com_example&task=item.display&id=1 which isn't easy to convey verbally or in writing. Search Engine Friendly (SEF) URLs are more human–readable, e.g. index.php/example/display/something.

sef_rewrite.description: Removes the index.php/ part from the URLs.

sef_suffix.title: Add Suffix to URL
sef_suffix.description: By default, Joomla URLs are "bare", without an extension. This options tells Joomla to add an extension such as .html, .feed etc based on the type of content being displayed by the URL.

unicodeslugs.title: Unicode Aliases
unicodeslugs.description: No: Joomla transliterates aliases which contain non–latin-1 characters using the transliteration engine provided by the Joomla language pack for the content's selected language, e.g. über becomes ueber for en-GB (English, Great Britain). Yes: Joomla does not transliterate aliases; the alias is used as is, e.g. über remains as–is.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Please select the mode you would like to use. If Normal Mode is chosen, then configure the module and it will display a static list of Articles on the menu items you assign the module to. If Dynamic Mode is chosen, then you can still configure the module normally, however now the Category option will no longer be used. Instead, the module will dynamically detect if you are on a Category view and will display the list of articles within that Category. When Dynamic Mode is chosen, it is best to leave the module set to display on all pages, as it will decide to display anything dynamically.
